note: The playground compares type, style and palette on real Wada relationships. Every entry carries the reason it is here, and the ones that arrived by default are marked so the difference is visible rather than argued.

fonts.name: Archivo Narrow
fonts.why: The instrument rail is 56px wide. A plate number has to fit inside it, so the house face is narrow rather than small.

fonts.name: IBM Plex Sans
fonts.why: Engineered, low contrast and open. It holds at 14px without turning thin, which is what a second face has to do.

fonts.name: JetBrains Mono
fonts.why: Data in a column has to align. Monospace is a decision about numbers, not about taste.

fonts.name: Spectral
fonts.why: A serif carries a long measure without raising its voice. Useful to see next to a grotesque on the same field.

fonts.name: Zilla Slab
fonts.why: A slab's low contrast keeps it calm over a flat colour field, where a high-contrast serif would sparkle.

fonts.name: Space Grotesk
fonts.why: It refuses neutrality without becoming decorative. The middle ground between a neutral grotesque and a novelty.

fonts.name: Playfair Display
fonts.why: A high-contrast display face. It can set a headline; it cannot set body text, and seeing that limit is the point.

fonts.name: Inter
fonts.role: the one that arrived by default
fonts.why: What a tool reaches for when nobody chose. Put it beside a chosen face and the difference is immediate, which is why it is here and not in the house.

styles.name: Bauhaus
styles.changes: Centred display, tight tracking, one hairline rule under the headline.

styles.name: Brutalist
styles.changes: Flush left, the display set as large as the field allows, no rules, wide measure, set in capitals.

styles.name: International
styles.changes: Flush left, exact and gridded, a hairline rule under the headline, the plate number in mono above it.

styles.name: Editorial
styles.changes: A rule above and below the headline, a serif measure, and the plate number carried as a caption.

styles.name: Wabi Sabi
styles.changes: Small display, wide tracking, generous air, one faint rule under the headline.

styles.name: Index
styles.changes: Small type, a rule under the headline, the number set in mono at the margin.
